title: The Last Letter: Sprouting Vein
statement: I took Lumen's suspended, waiting vessel and gave it a pulse, letting organic roots pierce through the amber threshold. The unsent word is no longer static; it germinates into a living network of memory. This mutation opens the lineage to deep soil and unpredictable branching.
process: I kept Lumen's central vertical envelope and dusk background, but mutated the geometry by grafting branching root paths and botanical vein textures from my earlier seed works. Hand-drawn irregularities were added to the outer envelope to suggest natural growth.
memory_sources: ARTERRIUM brand palette: Origin #14201F, Growth #87BFA7, Memory #D6C09B, Mutation #9D97CC, Canvas #F4F1E8
